text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on February 4, 2026. Mayor Chow, during the morning session of the meeting, gave remarks about the late Honourable Kirsty Duncan and extended condolences to Kirsty Duncan’s family, friends and colleagues. Speaker Nunziata, during the morning session of the meeting, called upon Mayor Chow to address City Council to recognize Shanley McNamee, General Manager, Children’s Services, on her retirement. Mayor Chow addressed City Council and gave remarks to recognize and celebrate the contributions of Shanley McNamee, General Manager, Children’s Services who served the City of Toronto for over 27 years. Mayor Chow welcomed Shanley’s husband, Brian, and children, Liam, Declan and Melissa, who were present in the Council Chamber, thanked Shanley McNamee for her service and presented her with a commemorative scroll.…
